full_prompt_en: A polished nineteenth-century salon oil painting shows a woman in a turquoise gown sitting beside a table piled with fruit. She turns toward the viewer and rests her chin lightly on one gloved hand, her other arm extending to the right. A wide black hat trimmed with turquoise flowers shades her auburn hair and softly lit face. Her dress combines a fitted turquoise bodice, broad turquoise skirt, black overskirt, white lace cuffs, and a pale central blouse with necklaces falling down its front. On the left, a fruit stand holds dark grapes, golden pears, oranges, and a red pomegranate above a richly patterned red cloth. The background is a saturated rusty red wall with faint ornamental motifs, giving the cool turquoise fabric a striking countercolor. The face is modeled with smooth ivory, rose, and warm gray transitions, while lace and silk shift into smaller, lively strokes. Dark gloves, hat, and drapery outline the brightly colored dress and organize the crowded fabric. Light enters gently from the left, catching skin, white lace, fruit, and the folds of the skirt; shadows remain warm and full of reflected color rather than flat black. The seated body makes a relaxed diagonal across the canvas, and the skirt forms a large low cool area beneath the warmer wall. The fruit at the edge adds a second cluster of rounded forms and glints. The surface is carefully finished at the face yet visibly brushed in the textiles and wallpaper, balancing formal elegance with rich painterly color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅细腻的十九世纪沙龙油画呈现一位穿青绿色长裙的女子坐在堆满水果的桌旁。她转向观者，一只戴手套的手轻托下颌，另一臂向右伸开。镶青绿花饰的宽黑帽遮住红褐发与柔和受光的面庞。衣裙结合贴身青绿上衣、宽大青绿裙摆、黑色罩裙、白蕾丝袖口，以及正面垂着项链的浅色内衫。左侧水果架放着深色葡萄、金黄梨、橙子和红石榴，下方是纹样繁复的红桌布。背景是饱和锈红墙面，带淡淡装饰纹，使冷青绿织物成为鲜明对色。脸由平滑象牙白、玫瑰色与暖灰过渡塑造，蕾丝和丝绸则转为更小、更活跃的笔触。暗手套、帽与垂布勾住亮色长裙，并组织拥挤布料。光从左侧温柔进入，碰亮肌肤、白蕾丝、水果和裙褶；阴影温暖且含反光颜色，而非平黑。坐姿沿画布形成放松斜线，裙摆在暖墙下构成宽阔的低位冷色区域。边缘水果增加一簇圆形和闪光。表面在面孔处精心收束，在织物与墙纸上保留可见画笔，使正式优雅与浓郁绘画色彩平衡。
style_prompt_en: Polished nineteenth-century salon oil painting balances smooth focal modeling with more visible, lively strokes in textiles and surrounding ornament. Saturated turquoise and cool teal form a large lower and central counterweight to a broad rusty-red field. Black masses outline the cool color, while ivory lace-like highlights and small golden-orange accents punctuate the scene. Soft side light rounds the important surfaces through gradual rose, cream, and warm-gray transitions; shadows retain reflected warmth instead of becoming dead black. A relaxed diagonal main form can sit above sweeping low folds, with a secondary compact cluster of rounded accents at one edge. Decorative background motifs stay faint enough to support the main contrast. Brush texture varies by material: supple and blended at the focal area, brisk and broken on fabric or patterned surfaces. Rich but controlled color and careful edge hierarchy give the result a formal, intimate, tactile elegance.
style_prompt_zh: 细腻的十九世纪沙龙油画平衡焦点处的平滑塑形与织物、周围装饰中更可见且活跃的笔触。饱和青绿与冷青色形成宽阔下部和中央重量，与大面积锈红色场相对。黑色体块勾住冷色，象牙白蕾丝般高光和微小金橙强调点断场景。柔和侧光通过玫瑰、奶油与暖灰渐层使重要表面圆润；阴影保有反射暖色，不变成死黑。放松的斜向主形可坐在扫过的低位褶皱之上，一侧有第二组紧凑圆形强调。装饰背景纹样保持浅淡，足以托住主对比。笔触随材质变化：焦点处柔韧融合，织物或纹样表面迅捷破碎。浓郁但受控的色彩与谨慎边缘层级带来正式、亲密、可触的优雅。
theme_en: A woman in a turquoise gown beside a table of fruit
theme_zh: 穿青绿色长裙的女子坐在水果桌旁
name: Raimundo de Madrazo y Garreta
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
